title: Dispatch Standing Basis: Notice, Service Windows and Hold Limits by Custom Application and Field Services Programme
content:
Three figures govern the application fleet's dispatch of work under Custom Application and Field Services: the notice a work order needs in business days before it is scheduled, the length of the window over which the plan's committed rates apply, and the longest that work may be held for field conditions before the plan is reconsidered. A fourth, the plan's place in the queue, decides which of two orders is worked first.

**Notice.** The notice figure is counted in business days, meaning days the plant dispatches.

**Service window.** The window figure is a length in calendar days. The Per-Acre Custom Application carries a window of 0 calendar days, which is to say no window of committed rates is written on that programme.

**Hold limit.** The hold limit is a length in calendar days measured from the day the hold was set.

| Programme | Notice before scheduling (business days) | Service window length (calendar days) | Longest hold for field conditions (calendar days) | Place in the scheduling queue |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Per-Acre Custom Application | 3 | 0 | 21 | standard queue |
| Season Commitment Application Plan | 3 | 120 | 21 | standard queue |
| Full-Service Agronomy Plan | 2 | 150 | 28 | priority queue |
| Variable Rate Prescription Plan | 3 | 150 | 28 | priority queue |
| Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan | 2 | 180 | 35 | first in the queue |
| Certified Anhydrous Application Plan | 5 | 45 | 14 | standard queue |

### Points of judgement on the figures

*Where two programmes carry the same window, do they carry the same notice?* Not necessarily. The Full-Service Agronomy Plan and the Variable Rate Prescription Plan both carry a window of 150 calendar days, but the first needs 2 business days of notice and the second needs 3.

*Which programme stands longest under a hold?* The Precision Partner Whole-Farm Plan, at 35 calendar days. The shortest is the Certified Anhydrous Application Plan, at 14.
